Bush Camping | Campsite | Barney View QLD, Australia
top of page
When it​'​​s time for a break from the ordinary,
experience nature first hand at...
FLANAGAN RESERVE BUSH CAMPING
Our reserve is located just 45kms south of Beaudesert and offers 28 acres of open bush camping.
Our reserve is completely 2wd accessible, and can take big rigs.
We have no marked campsites , you choose where you would like to camp.
All camping at our reserve is unpowered , however we do offer power points at our amenities block.
Showers are 20c coin operated ONLY (20c per minute)
OFFICE HOURS:
8:00am - 5:00pm (Sunday-Thursday)
8:00am-6:00pm (Saturday)
8:00am - 8:00pm (Friday)
(Hours will be extended during peak times)
If you are arriving outside these hours please call to make an alternative arrangement
ATTENTION PET OWNERS
We are a pet friendly park, however due to the recent lack of responsibility by pet owners, we have no choice but to enforce the following.
Any person bringing dogs into our reserve agrees to:
Pets Must be on a lead and restrained at all times, including the river. Unless in pet fencing at your campsite.
All pet leads MUST carry (2) bags minimum on them at all times in our park as instructed by local council.
All dog poo is to be picked up at ALL times, NO EXCUSES, and disposed of in the disposal point.
Fellow campers are asked to inform the office of irresponsible owners not abiding by park rules.
If any of the above occurs, you will be asked to take your pet home, with no refund given if you choose to go with your pet.

KIOSK & AMENITIES
The Kiosk / Office
The kiosk is where everyone is required to check in upon arrival.
We also have a wide range of items available for purchase, including, Firewood, Ice, Drinks & Snacks.
Amenities
We have showers and toilets located at the amenities block next to the kiosk. Hot showers are available and operate on 20c pieces for one minute of water. Please note that the showers will ONLY accept 20c coins.
Dog Friendly
What's a camping trip without your best friend?
We allow dogs here as long as they're not dangerous
Please ensure you read our conditions if bringing a dog

FAQ's | My Vxw Site 5wf91h
top of page
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What do you classify as peak times'?
Our peak times are all long weekends and Christmas holidays.
When is check-in and check-out?
You can arrive anytime from 8am and departure is anytime before 5pm.
What if I think I will arrive after hours?
Please give us a courtesy call to discuss an alternative arrangement if you will be arriving outside of office hours.
Do you have powered sites?
No, we are unpowered however we do have power at our amenities for charging devices etc.
Do you have amenities?
Yes, we have hot showers which are 20c coin operated for 1 minute of water. We also have flushing toilets.
Are you pet friendly?
We are pet friendly as long as your pet is friendly! Pets must always be on a lead. We have zero tolerance for pet droppings not being picked up after.
​
Can we have campfires and are the drums supplied?
Y es, campfires are allowed as long as there are no current fire bans issued. We supply the drums; they are scattered throughout the park for you to place at your campsite.
Does the family rate consist of four children from the same family?
When booking a family rate, this can be for up to and including four children, but they must be from the same immediate family.
Can we visit for the day?
Yes, day visitors are welcome between the hours of 9am and 5pm. There is no fee, however all day visitors must check-in at the office upon arrival.
What does the kiosk sell?
We sell cold drinks, ice creams, coffee, bread and general grocery items. Ice and Firewood are also available to purchase.
Can you fish in the river?
Yes you can fish in the river and no you don't need a permit. We encourage no bait otherwise you will catch turtles. The river has carp, bass and fresh water mullet.
Do you allow generators?
Generators are allowed, between strictly designated hours. 9am 11am and 4:30pm 7pm
Can we save room for others if booking/arriving separately?
Yes, you can save room for others (within reason). The only area you cannot do this is section G on site map.
